title: Snaketoshi Squares Base Board
subtitle: The meming of life
description: A Moksha Patam-inspired 72-square journey through snakes, ladders, lessons, market cycles, interfaith echoes, and memes.

tiles.title: Birth
tiles.meaning: The beginning of the journey. Every soul enters the game.
tiles.reflection: What am I beginning right now?

tiles.title: Illusion
tiles.meaning: The veil of appearances that hides deeper truth.
tiles.reflection: Where am I mistaking appearance for reality?

tiles.title: Anger
tiles.meaning: The fire that burns without wisdom.
tiles.reflection: What anger am I holding that no longer serves me?

tiles.title: Greed
tiles.meaning: The endless wanting that is never satisfied.
tiles.reflection: Where am I grasping instead of receiving?

tiles.title: Physical Plane
tiles.meaning: The realm of matter, sensation, and earthly experience.
tiles.reflection: How am I honoring my body and physical presence?

tiles.title: Delusion
tiles.meaning: Attachment to the unreal as if it were real.
tiles.reflection: What story am I telling myself that isn't true?

tiles.title: Vanity
tiles.meaning: Pride that separates us from truth and others.
tiles.reflection: Where is my ego asking to be seen instead of serving?

tiles.title: Envy
tiles.meaning: The poison of comparing your inside to another's outside.
tiles.reflection: Who am I comparing myself to, and why?

tiles.title: Sensual Plane
tiles.meaning: The realm of desire, pleasure, and earthly attachment.
tiles.reflection: What am I chasing that I think will complete me?

tiles.title: Purification
tiles.meaning: Cleansing of old patterns to reveal what is real.
tiles.reflection: What old layer am I ready to release?

tiles.title: Entertainment Plane
tiles.meaning: The world of art, music, beauty, and creative expression.
tiles.reflection: Where can I bring more beauty and play into my life?

tiles.title: Jealousy
tiles.meaning: Fear disguised as possessiveness.
tiles.reflection: What am I afraid of losing?

tiles.title: Right Action
tiles.meaning: Aligned action that serves the whole.
tiles.reflection: What is mine to do right now?

tiles.title: Astral Plane
tiles.meaning: The realm of energy, emotion, and subtle perception.
tiles.reflection: What am I feeling beneath the surface?

tiles.title: Desire
tiles.meaning: The longing that moves us toward union or distraction.
tiles.reflection: Is this desire pulling me closer to truth or further from it?

tiles.title: Good Tendencies
tiles.meaning: Actions rooted in kindness and clarity.
tiles.reflection: What good am I doing that I haven't acknowledged?

tiles.title: Mercy
tiles.meaning: Compassion that holds suffering with presence.
tiles.reflection: Who needs my compassion right now—including myself?

tiles.title: Heavenly Plane
tiles.meaning: The realm of joy, light, and temporary bliss.
tiles.reflection: What brings me joy without clinging?

tiles.title: Wrong Action
tiles.meaning: Action that harms the self or others.
tiles.reflection: Where have I acted out of alignment?

tiles.title: Discernment
tiles.meaning: The capacity to see what is real and what is not.
tiles.reflection: What truth am I avoiding?

tiles.title: Selfless Service
tiles.meaning: Giving without attachment to outcome or recognition.
tiles.reflection: How can I serve without needing to be seen?

tiles.title: Mental Plane
tiles.meaning: The realm of thought, intellect, and mental clarity.
tiles.reflection: What thoughts are running my life?

tiles.title: Good Company
tiles.meaning: The mirror of those who reflect truth back to you.
tiles.reflection: Who in my life helps me see clearly?

tiles.title: Bad Company
tiles.meaning: Relationships that pull you away from your center.
tiles.reflection: Who or what am I letting influence me unconsciously?

tiles.title: Charity
tiles.meaning: Generosity of spirit, resources, and presence.
tiles.reflection: What am I being called to give?

tiles.title: Piety
tiles.meaning: Devotion to what is sacred and true.
tiles.reflection: What do I hold as sacred in my life?

tiles.title: Plane of Austerity
tiles.meaning: The realm of discipline, sacrifice, and refinement.
tiles.reflection: What discipline is shaping me right now?

tiles.title: Correct Knowledge
tiles.meaning: Truth that aligns with reality, not belief.
tiles.reflection: What do I know to be true, beyond opinion?

tiles.title: Neutral Tendencies
tiles.meaning: Neither seeking nor avoiding, just present.
tiles.reflection: Where am I trying too hard to control the outcome?

tiles.title: Good Karma
tiles.meaning: The fruit of aligned action.
tiles.reflection: What harvest am I reaping from past choices?

tiles.title: Plane of Bliss
tiles.meaning: The realm of deep peace, stillness, and inner knowing.
tiles.reflection: When was the last time I felt truly at peace?

tiles.title: Plane of Balance
tiles.meaning: A place of balance, integration, and stabilization before entering deeper self-realization.
tiles.reflection: Where am I being asked to stabilize my energy before making the next move?

tiles.title: Plane of Fragrance
tiles.meaning: The subtle realm where essence is perceived before form.
tiles.reflection: What am I sensing before it becomes visible?

tiles.title: Plane of Taste
tiles.meaning: The realm of flavor, preference, and aesthetic discernment.
tiles.reflection: What is the flavor of my current experience?

tiles.title: Purgatory
tiles.meaning: The underworld of consequence and purification.
tiles.reflection: What consequence am I facing that I have been avoiding?

tiles.title: Clarity of Consciousness
tiles.meaning: The clear mirror of awareness, unstained by thought.
tiles.reflection: What becomes visible when I stop narrating my experience?

tiles.title: Wisdom
tiles.meaning: Wisdom as embodied knowing. This is not just information, but self-realized action.
tiles.reflection: What do I already know, but have not yet trusted?

interfaithReferences.quote: Be wise as serpents and harmless as doves
interfaithReferences.commentary: Wisdom without predation; harmlessness without naivety.

memeEncounters.caption: Get out there and meme spiritual enlightenment
memeEncounters.prompt: Angry man pointing at the mirror with Pepe speaking back.

memeEncounters.caption: I guess… make me one with everything.
memeEncounters.prompt: Disheveled Pepe in line at a hot dog stand with religious figures impatiently standing behind him.

tiles.title: Plane of Reality
tiles.meaning: The realm of absolute truth, beyond perception.
tiles.reflection: What is real when all stories fall away?

tiles.title: Inner Space
tiles.meaning: The gap between thoughts where presence lives.
tiles.reflection: Where is the silence in my life?

tiles.title: Plane of Luminosity
tiles.meaning: The radiant dimension where light is self-aware.
tiles.reflection: What in me is already awake?

tiles.title: Cosmic Consciousness
tiles.meaning: Union with the infinite field of awareness.
tiles.reflection: When have I felt most connected to everything?

tiles.title: Plane of Birth and Rebirth
tiles.meaning: The cycle of return, again and again, until freedom.
tiles.reflection: What pattern keeps repeating in my life?

tiles.title: Humanity
tiles.meaning: The beautiful, flawed, holy experience of being human.
tiles.reflection: Where am I being too hard on myself for being human?

tiles.title: Ignorance
tiles.meaning: Not knowing what you do not know.
tiles.reflection: What blind spot is becoming visible?

tiles.title: Bad Tendencies
tiles.meaning: Patterns that lead away from wholeness.
tiles.reflection: What habit am I defending that doesn't serve me?

tiles.title: Egotism
tiles.meaning: The false sense of a separate, solid self.
tiles.reflection: Where am I taking things personally that aren't about me?

tiles.title: Conscience
tiles.meaning: The inner voice that knows right from wrong.
tiles.reflection: What is my conscience telling me that I am ignoring?

tiles.title: Spiritual Devotion
tiles.meaning: Surrender to what is greater than the personal self.
tiles.reflection: What am I being asked to trust?

tiles.title: Phenomenal Plane
tiles.meaning: The manifest world of form, change, and appearance.
tiles.reflection: What am I treating as permanent that is obviously changing?

tiles.title: Fluid Energy
tiles.meaning: The water element—flow, adaptability, and emotional depth.
tiles.reflection: Where do I need to soften and flow instead of resist?

tiles.title: False Knowledge
tiles.meaning: Believing something untrue to be true.
tiles.reflection: What 'fact' am I holding that might just be a story?

tiles.title: Plane of Violence
tiles.meaning: The realm where harm is inflicted, consciously or not.
tiles.reflection: Where am I being violent—toward myself or others?

tiles.title: Earth Energy
tiles.meaning: The grounding element of stability, form, and matter.
tiles.reflection: How am I grounding myself in the present moment?

tiles.title: Fire Energy
tiles.meaning: The transforming element of heat, digestion, and light.
tiles.reflection: What in me is being burned away?

tiles.title: Attachment
tiles.meaning: The sticky grip of wanting things to stay as they are.
tiles.reflection: What am I clinging to that wants to leave?

tiles.title: Air Energy
tiles.meaning: The moving element of breath, wind, and change.
tiles.reflection: What new wind is blowing through my life?

tiles.title: Ether
tiles.meaning: The spacious element that holds all other elements.
tiles.reflection: Where do I need more space in my life?

tiles.title: Supreme Energy
tiles.meaning: The unchanging awareness beneath all experience.
tiles.reflection: What in me has never changed?

tiles.title: Absolute Self
tiles.meaning: The true self, beyond body, mind, and identity.
tiles.reflection: Who am I when no one is looking?

tiles.title: Plane of Primal Vibration
tiles.meaning: The realm of sound, frequency, and the creative word.
tiles.reflection: What is the sound of my soul right now?

tiles.title: Primal Vibration
tiles.meaning: The first sound, the cosmic hum, the resonance of all that is.
tiles.reflection: When I sit in silence, what vibration do I feel?

tiles.title: Supreme Bliss
tiles.meaning: The bliss that is not dependent on anything external.
tiles.reflection: When was the last time I felt joy for no reason?

tiles.title: Plane of the Dark Night
tiles.meaning: The underworld journey where light is temporarily hidden.
tiles.reflection: What darkness am I afraid to sit with?

tiles.title: Plane of Non-Duality
tiles.meaning: The realm where separation dissolves into oneness.
tiles.reflection: Where am I creating a boundary that doesn't exist?

tiles.title: Void
tiles.meaning: Emptiness that is full, the ground of all form.
tiles.reflection: What happens when I stop filling the silence?

tiles.title: Plane of Renunciation
tiles.meaning: The realm of letting go without aversion.
tiles.reflection: What am I ready to release with love?

tiles.title: Reality
tiles.meaning: That which is, always has been, and always will be.
tiles.reflection: What is here that cannot be taken away?

tiles.title: Cosmic Good
tiles.meaning: The goodness woven into the fabric of existence.
tiles.reflection: Where can I trust that life is supporting me?

tiles.title: Absolute Truth
tiles.meaning: The truth beyond all relative truths.
tiles.reflection: What do I know that cannot be argued with?

tiles.title: Plane of Saturation
tiles.meaning: The fullness where nothing more is needed.
tiles.reflection: Where am I already complete?

tiles.title: Universal Consciousness
tiles.meaning: Awareness that includes all beings, all worlds, all experience.
tiles.reflection: What would I do if I knew we are all one?

tiles.title: Liberation
tiles.meaning: Freedom from the game. You have arrived.
tiles.reflection: What does it feel like to be free?
